plan.title: Forward auction auto-title for same-family products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Set the event type to Auction; the catalog has no forward/sell direction control.
Apply the first available auction template; the exact forward template cannot be selected by the catalog.
Add two line items to exercise the multi-product auto-title behavior.
Set the first item's location to the location named in the case.
Confirm the first location value was accepted.
Set the second item's location to the same named location.
Confirm the second location value was accepted.
